config.terralith.option.custom_structure: Spawns custom structures, such as Fortified Villages and Mage Towers.
config.terralith.option.fog_tweaks.toolt: Changes fog distance and color is some biomes, such as swamps and caves.
config.terralith.option.intro_message.to: Shows a toast when creating a new world, giving discord link and warning about difficulties when trying to uninstall.
config.terralith.option.recipe_changes.t: Allows some items crafted with cobblestone to be crafted with alternate stones, and adds a recipe for converting stone slabs to cobblestone.
config.terralith.option.skylands.tooltip: A set of four season-themed biomes generating as sky islands above deep oceans.
config.terralith.option.terrain_slabs.to: In biomes with surface stone, stone slabs will generate to smooth the terrain.
config.terralith.option.vanilla_stone_ge: Follows Vanilla behavior and generates small blobs of granite, andesite, and diorite throughout the underground.
config.terralith.text.warning: This config is universal and will be applied whenever you load into a world, with generation configs taking effect in newly loaded chunks.
config.terralith.title: Terralith Config
